//: Typechecks the declaration files this package ships as its `types`, and
tests/types, which uses them as a caller would. Listed file by file on
purpose: the runtime is plain JavaScript and is not compiled, so a glob
over lib would start typechecking lib/*.js.
`skipLibCheck` is off deliberately. It defaults to true almost everywhere,
which is exactly why nothing had ever checked these 2400 lines -- and why
a consumer who turns it off is the one who finds the problems.
